Young Luka Doncic PUT ON A SHOW vs Valanciunas & Sabonis!
Luka Doncic delivered a SPECTACULAR performance against Lithuania at the FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament 2020!
Going up against Jonas Valanciunas and Domantas Sabonis, Luka showed off his incredible scoring, court vision and playmaking, proving that he was already a special talent on the international stage.
Watch the BEST moments from Young Luka Doncic as he faced Lithuania in the battle for a spot at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games!
